name: How long does storm-damage home restoration usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does storm-damage home restoration usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Storm-damage restoration timelines depend on the extent of the damage, drying times, and material sourcing. Minor repairs, such as localized drywall replacement and interior painting from a roof leak, usually take two to five days. Major structural restorations involving compromised custom framing, subfloor reconstruction, or exterior wall repair can take several weeks. Promptly drying saturated materials and finalizing scope assessments with adjusters prevents underlying framing rot and shortens overall project duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor repairs like patching drywall and painting take 2 to 5 days, while extensive projects involving custom framing or floor replacement can take several weeks.
